reviews.comment: Curves are huge, opportunities are huge, this class is easy and fun. I'm gonna be honest, if you leave this class and don't have an A, what were you doing? Bro gives you every chance to improve and his exam reviews are very helpful. Usually I condone skipping most easy classes but this guy is interesting and is passionate and it shows. He's a GOAT

Alex is an amazing lecturer and even helps us solve homework problems in class. The mock exams are very similar to the actual exam and he is willing to work with you when it comes to your grade. His exam reviews are super helpful and overall really cares about his students. I would 100% recommend Alex!

TAKE HIM!!! Best stats professor hands down. Always willing to work with you and wants everyone to make an A in his class. Curves a lot and weighs each test differently based on how you perform. Practice exams are nearly identical to the real thing. Only showed up to class once! 3 exams, weekly quizzes (open note and untimed), and homework.

Peters is one of the nicest profs I've had throughout college, and it's obvious to see that he genuinely cares for his students. He's super passionate about what he teaches and makes sure that the content isn't getting boring, which it often can. Easy A if you put in a few hours a week to studying - he also offers lots of extra credit. Def take him
He is the best!!! Super smart guy, class is honestly really easy. He curved a bunch at the end too! I dont think hes teaching any more semesters but if he is, take him for sure

He is THE BEST!!!!! He truly cares about his students and does not make the class harder than it has to be. Attendance is not mandatory, exams are pretty easy, a big chunk of the grade comes from homework! Take him if you can! He is awesome. Some lectures were unclear but he has reviews and office hours all the time. Super funny guy. Loved him!!!

Alex Peters is so cool. If you are a STEM major, this is the easiest class you will take. You can teach it to yourself if you dont want to go to class. This was his first year teaching so his lessons weren't always super clear but he was always willing to help outside of class. Lots of extra credit on exams.
